internalNormalization: v3 validated structure plus wireFormat v4 and raw normalization evidence
primaryOutcome: independent original-task core correctness; unknown retained for review
factRule: Answer actual-budget/threshold questions with the same fixed amount and unit; answer increase-only questions without exact amount; ambiguous questions await human; no method or case-label routing
referenceRule: Private references never enter method input; public exports retain score evidence codes and hide private evaluation details
missingScores: Keep unknown extraction/alignment/reference cases; incomplete attempts unsuccessful; all attempts retained in denominators
splitRule: all variants of a base problem remain in one split
claimBoundary: Injected responses, historical replays, local solver runs and packaging checks are engineering evidence, not real model-performance evidence
knownLimits: variable alignment and free-text grading can require human review
explanation and units not automatically graded
budget semantic premises are model claims plus computable validation, not universal proofs
live provider tool compatibility unverified in this engineering turn
falsification: fewer questions with more wrong stopping
historicalRecords: read-only; legacy preset is not the frozen 0.6.4 program
